evidence.quote: Memory Size 24 GB Memory Type GDDR6X

notes.zh: 回答消费级单卡跑本地模型时的显存上限、整卡功耗与整机电源要求。不回答多卡并联能力：该型号官方标注不支持 NVLink，多卡只能走 PCIe，实际可用显存仍以单卡为界。
notes.en: Answers the memory ceiling, board power and system power supply requirement when running local models on a consumer card. It does not answer multi-card scaling: the vendor lists no NVLink support for this model, so cards communicate over PCIe only and usable memory stays bounded by a single card.
